question.text: With effect from 1 July 2020, what is the stamp duty on (i) issue of units of an AIF and (ii) transfer of units of an AIF?

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook Para 16.7: effective 1 July 2020, stamp duty on issue of AIF units is 0.005% and on transfer of AIF units is 0.015%. The Fund pays on behalf of the investors at the time of issuance or transfer. No stamp duty on redemptions. The Trap: Option B reverses the two rates. Option C invents a higher issuance rate. Option D is symmetric but wrong. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C Compliance expects the manager to wire this into the NAV accounting for first-close drawdowns. Manager's Pro-Tip: When running a second close or top-up, the 0.005% stamp duty applies again on each fresh issuance — model this as a frictional cost in the tail of the fund.
